data.title: 白金 · 晨光微醺的落地窗前
data.description: 【主卧落地窗前·清晨】初升的薄暖朝阳透过白纱帘洒在厚地毯上。白金微仰着头舒展着纤细双臂伸懒腰，宽大的白衬衫领口自然滑落半边，银白长发如瀑散落，带着初醒时慵懒迷蒙的轻吟。
data.location: 主卧飘窗与落地白纱前
data.action: 高举双臂舒展懒腰轻微回眸
data.lighting: 逆光白纱透射的柔金晨雾光晕
data.promptProse: Standing beside floor-to-ceiling sheer curtains in a tranquil sunlit bedroom at dawn, Platinum raises both arms in a languid stretch and looks back with drowsy affection and a soft blush. Her oversized unbuttoned white shirt slips off one shoulder over her bare legs as golden morning sunbeams rim her white hair.
data.animaCaption: Standing before fluttering white sheer curtains with both arms raised in a sleepy morning stretch, she glances back with a faint blush as her oversized white shirt slips off one shoulder. Golden sunrise backlighting outlines her hair and sheer silhouettes through the fabric.
data.nsfwProse: She wears only an oversized unbuttoned crisp white dress shirt slipping off one shoulder to reveal her collarbone and bare legs.
